sloka: निवृत्त कर्म आयतनो नूनम् संचित संचयः ।आषाढीम् अभ्युपगतो भरतः कोसल अधिपः ॥४-२८-५५॥
transliteration: nivṛtta karma āyatano nūnam saṁcita saṁcayaḥ ।āṣāḍhīm abhyupagato bharataḥ kosala adhipaḥ ॥4-28-55॥

translations.english: 'Surely Bharata, king of Kosala, would have completed the collection of all his requirement before the commencement of the month of Asarh.
